_meta.note: Canvas text for the v2 rooms (room/2): room names, the hints the hint animals give, a few play-test lines and the HUD. The Chinese table mirrors each room's name and hints[].text (tests/rooms2.test.mjs). Kept apart from content/i18n/, whose tables feed the content hash of approved screens.

room2.diyu_fengdu.name: Fengdu · The Bell Tower Gong
room2.diyu_fengdu.hint.0: Push the paper float over the pit: the crate rides along on top.
room2.diyu_fengdu.hint.1: Step onto the float and push the crate under the bell tower as a step.
room2.diyu_fengdu.hint.2: Climb the crate up the bell tower and strike the gong: the city gate opens.
room2.diyu_fengdu.hint.3: Take the ladder down and go through the city gate.
room2.diyu_gate.name: Ghost Gate
room2.diyu_ghostfire.name: Will-o'-Wisp Gallery
room2.diyu_home_hall.name: Recipient's Home · Judge's Hall
room2.diyu_home_yard.name: Recipient's Home · Ancestors' Yard
room2.diyu_huangquan.name: Yellow Springs Road · Catch Your Breath
room2.diyu_lantern.name: Lantern Dock · Push It Out of the Slot
room2.diyu_lantern.hint.0: Jump into the slot and walk into the end of the float from the side: it moves when pushed.
room2.diyu_lantern.hint.1: The float hangs over the pit and won't fall: step on and walk across.
room2.diyu_naihe.name: Naihe Bridge · One at a Time
room2.diyu_naihe.hint.0: Naihe Bridge holds only one: push the crate onto the bridge first.
room2.diyu_naihe.hint.1: Push once more: with you and the crate both on it, the bridge gives way, and the crate lands on the plate below.
room2.diyu_naihe.hint.2: The door is open: climb the crate to the ladder and walk across.
room2.diyu_paper_bridge.name: Paper Float · Lanterns Weigh Nothing
room2.diyu_paper_bridge.hint.0: Push the paper float onto the bridge: the float and its crate weigh nothing, so only you count.
room2.diyu_paper_bridge.hint.1: Step onto the float and push the crate onto the plate on the far bank.
room2.diyu_paper_bridge.hint.2: The door is open: climb over the crate.
room2.diyu_sand_bridge.name: Yellow Sand · Sand Has Weight Too
room2.diyu_sand_bridge.hint.0: Dig a bag of Yellow Springs sand.
room2.diyu_sand_bridge.hint.1: Pour the sand on the bridge: sand has weight too, one cell counts as one.
room2.diyu_sand_bridge.hint.2: Step on the sand pile: the bridge gives way, and the sand lands on the plate below.
room2.diyu_sand_bridge.hint.3: The door is open: climb the ladder and walk across.
room2.diyu_teahouse.name: Post Station · Bridgehead Tea Stall
room2.diyu_wangchuan.name: Wangchuan Ford · Wood Floats, Iron Sinks
room2.diyu_wangchuan.hint.0: The wooden crate floats on the Wangchuan: push it in as a stepping stone.
room2.diyu_wangchuan.hint.1: The iron crate sinks: push it into the shallow pool to hold down the plate underwater.
room2.diyu_wangchuan.hint.2: Jump into the slot and push the paper float out across the river.
room2.diyu_wangchuan.hint.3: Cross the river on the paper float.
room2.diyu_wangxiang.name: Homesick Terrace · The Basket Is Stuck
room2.diyu_wangxiang.hint.0: The basket can't go down: the door in the shaft is shut, and its plate is at the bottom of the well. Push the iron crate in: it sinks.
room2.diyu_wangxiang.hint.1: The door is open: get back on the basket and press the button again.
room2.diyu_wangxiang.hint.2: You're at the bottom: walk out.
room2.dungeon2_bridge.name: Broken Bridge · Push the Float Stone
room2.dungeon2_bridge.hint.0: Walk into one end of the float stone to push it; it hangs in the air and won't fall.
room2.dungeon2_bridge.hint.1: When it won't go any farther, step on and walk across the pit on top of it.
room2.dungeon2_corridor.name: Rat Run · Catch Your Breath
room2.dungeon2_ferry.name: Crate Ferry · Stone Carries Cargo
room2.dungeon2_ferry.hint.0: The float stone carries the crate along: push it across the pit.
room2.dungeon2_ferry.hint.1: Step onto the float stone and push the crate onto the plate on the far bank.
room2.dungeon2_ferry.hint.2: The door is open: climb the crate over the low wall.
room2.dungeon2_gate.name: Ferry Gate · Rune Prison
room2.dungeon2_home.name: Recipient's Home · Cell Cottage
room2.dungeon2_pole.name: Push Off · Dig from a Float Stone
room2.dungeon2_pole.hint.1: Dig at the wall behind you: if it won't give, you push off, and the stone drifts one cell the other way.
room2.dungeon2_sandpour.name: Sand Well · Pour from a Float Stone
room2.dungeon2_sandpour.hint.0: First dig a bag of sand.
room2.dungeon2_sandpour.hint.1: Stand on the right end of the float stone and pour the sand into the pit: it falls to the bottom and holds down the plate.
room2.dungeon2_sandpour.hint.2: The door is open: push off the bank to reach the far side.
room2.dungeon2_station.name: Post Station · Cell Block Branch
room2.dungeon2_well.name: Down the Well · Pole All the Way
room2.dungeon2_well.hint.0: Jump onto the float stone and push off the bank you came from.
room2.dungeon2_well.hint.1: Push this one left: walk to its right end and use the shovel on the stone wall.
room2.dungeon2_well.hint.3: Drop onto the stone ledge below and leave to the right.
room2.dungeon2_yard.name: Exercise Yard · The Lever on the Ledge
room2.dungeon2_yard.hint.0: Push the float stone to carry the crate across the pit.
room2.dungeon2_yard.hint.1: Push the crate under the ledge as a step.
room2.dungeon2_yard.hint.2: Climb the ledge and pull the lever: the lower door opens.
room2.dungeon2_yard.hint.3: Take the ladder down and go through the lower door.
dlg.fauna.dungeon_bat.fed: I only pass on the cat's word: feed the cat.
dlg.fauna.diyu_butterfly.fed: I only show the white dog's way: feed the dog.
dlg.r2.hurt: Too high: that drop would hurt.
dlg.r2.no_hint: Nothing to hint here: head for the exit.
dlg.r2.done_hint: All done: head for the exit.
room2.jeju_gate.name: Harbor · Arrival at the Gate
room2.jeju_olle.name: Olle · Stone-wall Lane
room2.jeju_canola.name: Canola Fields
room2.jeju_haenyeo_house.name: Post Station · Haenyeo House
room2.jeju_home_shore.name: Recipient's Home · Breakwater
room2.jeju_home_orchard.name: Recipient's Home · Tangerine Orchard
room2.jeju_home_cave.name: Recipient's Home · Lava Cave
dlg.fauna.jeju_dragonfly.fed: I only show the pony's way: feed the pony.
room2.jeju_neolttwigi.name: Neolttwigi · One End Falls, One End Flies
room2.jeju_neolttwigi.hint.0: Open the door above the wood crate, go around to the right of the iron crate and push it down the shaft. The launched wood crate holds the exit plate.
room2.jeju_baramgil.name: Baramgil · Let the Wind Push
room2.jeju_baramgil.hint.0: The wall blocks access behind the wood crate. Walk a few steps so the wind blows it into the deep pit, then use it as a step across.
room2.jeju_pier.name: Pier · Iron Still Counts Underwater
room2.jeju_pier.hint.0: Go under the pier to the right of the iron crate and push it into the water shaft. Return underneath, then climb the launched wood crate onto the pier.
room2.jeju_terrace.name: Orchard Terrace · A Bag of Soil Has Weight
room2.jeju_terrace.hint.0: Dig the soil above the wood crate, carry it over the upper path and stand on the right plate. Pour left to launch the crate, then climb to the terrace.
room2.jeju_doldam.name: Doldam · An Iron Brake
room2.jeju_doldam.hint.0: Take the lower passage to the right ladder and step onto the entry plate to release the wind. Immediately push the iron crate left into the right pit so the wood crate stops on the left plate.
room2.jeju_dodaebul.name: Dodaebul · Let the Wind Drop the Weight
room2.jeju_dodaebul.hint.0: Climb down to the base of the beacon and stand on the right end of the seesaw. Press Up to open the door: the wind drops the wood crate into the left shaft and launches you onto the ledge.
